hypothesis: Promoting the E39 Spine+Chest action mask into default production behavior reproduces the complete locked causal-standing bundle without any experimental behavior arguments.

causal_variable.name: production_default_standing_action_mask
causal_variable.candidate: joints 0-7 and 9-10 retained; joint 8 and joints 11-22 zero

held_constant: E39 model, protocol, evaluator thresholds, timestep, perturbation and seed
implementation_plan: Change the production compatibility-mask contract test first so default standing retains exactly joints 0-7 and 9-10.
Run the focused Unreal test red against the current lower-only default.
Promote Spine+Chest in the production default and inference path without altering development selectors for other regions.
Run focused green tests and commit production behavior.
Run Normal x3, ZeroActions x3, DropControlDispatch x1 and ForcedSupportLoss x1 with no PhysAnimExperimental arguments.
Audit masks, first-active evidence, strengths, hashes, deterministic streams, model/protocol identity and destructive controls.

decision_rule.supported: Record production success and use the promoted Spine+Chest behavior as the new immutable upper-body restoration baseline.
decision_rule.falsified: Revert production default to E33 lower-only behavior and retain E39 as development-only evidence.
decision_rule.invalid: Repeat only for a violated validity condition.
